pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Individual dark brown regions exhibit highly irregular, stellate boundaries with high-frequency pixel-level serrations. The geometries are roughly polygonal with star-like extensions protruding into the interstitial spaces.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-tan pathways separating the dark patches. The topological graph consists of narrow, consistently thick corridors with clearly defined trivalent and tetravalent junction nodes.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple avian organisms (oxpeckers) perched along the dorsal ridge and mid-flank, creating external silhouette interruptions.
